title: Ready times of the carries in a 16-bit ripple-carry and a carry look-ahead adder
intro: Each box is one carry, c16 on the left, c1 on the right. It fills with its ready time when it settles. Every gate costs one unit.

elements.text: 16-bit adder: when each carry is ready (unit gate delays)

steps.caption: t = 3: ripple: c1 ready; look-ahead: c1, c2, c3 ready. Both adders have c1, but look-ahead also has c2 and c3.
t = 5: ripple: c2 ready; look-ahead: c8, c12, c16 ready.
t = 6: look-ahead: c5, c6, c7 ready.
t = 7: ripple: c3 ready; look-ahead: c9, c10, c11, c13, c14, c15 ready.
t = 8: look-ahead's last sum done at 8.
t = 33: ripple: c16 ready; ripple done at 33.
